description:
Bar revised 2026-11-15 by the user: the pull system's removal is worth a measured rise. The revised prediction after fz-t93.23 is +1.4..+1.8% of the distiller run. Each step still reports its own number and every pin rise is approved. Further savings are taken on the simpler codebase afterwards (fz-t93.22 is parked until then).

Measured at e81f9ed52 (2026-11-15; page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-t93.7-measured.html, scratch t93_7/m/report.md): at today's engine cost per job the end state is predicted +4.8% of the distiller run (0..+11%), so the bar below is not met. The user kept the bar. The steps are children fz-t93.7.1-.7, chained, and step 1 waits on fz-t93.23 (cheaper fan-out jobs).

The pull system is gone. Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-next.html (E3). fz-t93.6 (transport shapes) and fz-t93.4 (recursive product groups) are FOLDED here (2026-11-14): neither buys anything until the pull system is deleted, so they are one step.

Buys: deletes pull.rs, pull/, product_drive.rs (8,215 lines with tests), ProductMemo readers/readiness, the mutation wave, rooted witnesses, pull Tarjan (pending_strong_component), session retirement, and all ten ProductKey families: one way to demand a key and one cycle mechanism. Pull bookkeeping costs ~0.97G (~19.9k per product request, 6.3% of the distiller; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/t93_6/round5.md).

How (spiked, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/t93_6/round4.md, spike_r4.diff):
- Transport shapes are two facts per executable: Iface(root, executable) = ExecutableInput/ExecutableReturn layouts; Body(root, executable) = every other position (member set derived from ExecutableFacts). A job computes its own positions inline; a foreign Input/Return position is ONE Iface read. changed only when layouts differ. Interface edges are acyclic (36 executable SCCs over 192 executables; 0 over interface edges; Return->Return survives only callee id > owner id, cut_in_component_returns). Spike: identical output, fixture_matrix 3442/0, no deadlock, 12,505/12,505 foreign reads served by Iface; -1.0% with a Reach stand-in, -0.6..+0.6% with honest Reach (estimate); incremental probe: body edit re-runs only own facts, interface edit re-runs callers only.
- Reach(root, node) is a fact whose job walks edge facts and records every read; no Reach fact reads another, so no group.
- The shape job computes the local callable construction itself (no CallableConstruction product round-trip).
- ExecutableEffects, CallableConstruction and the artifacts convert bottom-up so products only wait on facts (avoids the same-root product-wait driver deadlock fz-t93.4 hit).
- Engine retirement: a retired root withdraws its demand (today only pull sessions retire: compiler.rs:390, pull.rs:2108).

Bar: distiller instructions <= base after fz-t93.19; edit re-run counts no worse than today's mutation wave on the same edits (measure today's first). Paper first: proposal page with predictions.

--- original fz-t93.7 ---
RootBackendProduct, NativeProgram, BackendExecutable, AbiExecutable, MaterializedExecutable, StructSchema become engine derivations. Retiring a root withdraws its demand and the engine releases what nothing demands. Failed is a producer outcome with FatalError's contract (pull.rs documents it so). Deletes ProductMemo readers/readiness/rooted membership witness, ProductMutationWave, PullSession scheduling, ProductSessions routing, DependencyKey::Product, product_drive.rs as a separate drive. Docs: fact-engine.md 'Product pulls for artifacts' folds into the engine sections; pipeline.md artifact path.

--- folded fz-t93.6 ---
TransportShape(position) (61% of distiller product requests: 31,177 of 51,196) becomes an engine derivation scoped to its root. First root-scoped key in the engine: scope is a key attribute; values live in a store outside the core (the core keeps revisions only). Predict and measure requests/evaluations/instructions on the distiller and add.fz.

--- folded fz-t93.4 ---
ExecutableEffects(E) and CallableConstruction(position) become engine derivations whose group concludes together. Deletes pull.rs pending_strong_component (16,005 calls on the distiller, 651 closed searches over 389 distinct pairs, groups up to 101), the pending-record cycle evidence, and with it the 168 missed cycles (records dropped by settle Wake 123 / Invalidate 39 / both 6). Predict: dumps identical; missed cycles 0.

Spiked 2026-11-14 on e47d83e40 (scratchpad t93_4/findings.md, spike.diff, tests_spike.log; ExecutableEffects only): dumps and outputs identical, but +1.0% distiller instructions (12.44G -> 12.58G, n=5) and +3,345 DeriveExecutableEffects jobs. An engine job's product wait on a same-root product deadlocks today's driver: the active drive's scope parks the request until the drive ends, the drive waits on the job. The spike needed a take_parked nested-drive bridge (1,103 extra drives) and still failed macro_product_test ('runtime demand with no ready producer') and a public_trace scenario ('product movement outside a session'). Premise correction: pending_strong_component's calls and missed cycles are mostly Reach (8,776 calls, 155 of 155 missed cycles after ExecutableEffects moves; CallableConstruction 3,471 calls, 0 missed). So this step cannot delete pending_strong_component alone. Reordered AFTER fz-t93.7: once Materialized is a derivation, the wait is an ordinary fact wait and needs no bridge.
title: The pull system is gone
